messages.content: who played the oldest brother in 7th heaven

message.content:
The **oldest brother** in *7th Heaven* was **Matt Camden**, played by **Barry Watson**.[2][3]

If you meant the **oldest sibling overall**, that was **Mary Camden**, played by **Jessica Biel**.
